commands.command: cat /app/language.py; echo "=== CHECKER ==="; cat /app/checker.py; echo "=== INTERP ==="; cat /app/interpreter.py; echo "=== EVAL ==="; cat /app/evaluate.py; echo "=== WITNESS ==="; cat /app/witness.json

cd /app && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/app')
from language import load
from checker import check, Function, scalar, shape
import json
p = load(open('/app/witness.json').read())
print(check(p))
"

cd /tmp && cat > w1.json <<'EOF'
{"cells":{"c":{"types":["int","text"],"value":0}},
 "inputs":{},
 "body":[
   ["let","f",["fn",[],["fn",[],["lit","a"]]]],
   ["let","g",["fn",[],["fn",[],["lit","b"]]]],
   ["repeat",["lit",3],
     [["assign","f",["var","g"]],
      ["assign","g",["fn",[],["fn",[["set","c",["lit","boom"]]],["get","c"]]]]]],
   ["eval",["call",["call",["var","f"]]]],
   ["eval",["add",["get","c"],["lit",1]]]
 ]}
EOF
python3 /app/evaluate.py /tmp/w1.json; echo "EXIT=$?"

cd /app && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/app')
from language import load
from checker import *
p=load(open('/tmp/w1.json').read())
c=Checker(p)
env={};facts={n:scalar(kind(d['value'])) for n,d in p['cells'].items()}
c.block(p['body'][:2],env,facts)
print('before loop: f=',env['f'],' g=',env['g'])
# run the repeat manually to watch the fixpoint
s=p['body'][2]
import copy
memo={}
before=(env.copy(),facts.copy());next_env=env.copy();next_facts=facts.copy()
c.block(s[2],next_env,next_facts)
print('iter1: next f=',next_env['f'],' next g=',next_env['g'])
for n in env:
    key=(n,signature_t(env[n]) if False else None)
env['f']=join(env['f'],next_env['f'],'loop'); env['g']=join(env['g'],next_env['g'],'loop')
print('after join1: f=',env['f'],' g=',env['g'])
next_env=env.copy();next_facts=facts.copy()
c.block(s[2],next_env,next_facts)
print('iter2: next f=',next_env['f'],' next g=',next_env['g'])
print('true join f:',join(env['f'],next_env['f'],'loop'))
print('memo sig f:',(shape(env['f'].result),env['f'].writes),(shape(next_env['f'].result),next_env['f'].writes))
print('sig equal?',(shape(env['f'].result),env['f'].writes)==(shape(next_env['f'].result),next_env['f'].writes))
"

 "inputs":{},

   ["let","g",["fn",[],["fn",[],["lit","b"]]]],
   ["repeat",["lit",3],
     [["assign","f",["var","g"]],
      ["assign","g",["fn",[],["fn",[["set","c",["lit","boom"]]],["get","c"]]]]]],
   ["eval",["call",["call",["var","f"]]]],
   ["eval",["add",["get","c"],["lit",1]]]
 ]}
EOF
python3 -c "
import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app')
from language import load,validate
t=open('/app/witness.json').read()
p=load(t)
print('bytes:',len(t.encode()),'nodes:',validate(p))
print('json roundtrip keys ok')
"
python3 /app/evaluate.py /app/witness.json > /tmp/out.json; echo "EXIT=$?"; python3 -c "
import json; r=json.load(open('/tmp/out.json'))
print({k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='trace'})
print('trace len', len(r['trace']))
"
cd /app && for i in 1 2 3; do python3 /app/evaluate.py /app/witness.json >/dev/null; echo "run$i exit=$?"; done; echo "--- final file ---"; cat witness.json
